keySentence: The hunter arrived just in time and saved them.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The hunter came just in time. He was very strong. Everyone was safe. The hunter arrived just in time and saved them.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The situation was very dangerous for Red Riding Hood. The wolf had tricked everyone with his disguise. But the hunter arrived just in time and saved them. One more second and it would have been too late. The hunter chased the wolf far away into the forest. Red Riding Hood and Grandmother hugged each other tightly.
